_views.text: Archive is the living memory of Luna. It records every significant action: ritual invocations, Nucleus state changes, Chronos modifications, system resets. Each entry carries a timestamp (HH:MM:SS), a trace description, and the name of the module that emitted the event. The last 10 entries are displayed newest on top in a scrollable panel. Archive never modifies existing entries — it only appends. History is inviolable.
